SELECT seq_product.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO product ( product_no, name, price, discount_rate, category_id, description, use_yn, created_at, updated_at, view_count, same_day_delivery_yn ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{name}, #{price}, #{discountRate}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{useYn}, SYSTIMESTAMP, NULL, 0, #{sameDayDeliveryYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no AS productNo, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, pi.image_url AS imageUrl FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_no = pi.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY p.product_no DESC
